lines.en: 「It had taken a very long time to reach that decision.」
I looked at Yoo Joonghyuk as he made his quiet declaration.
This hadn’t been the plan. Yoo Joonghyuk was supposed to use the memories of the 999th round to buy time.
He had to provoke the ‘Outer Gods’ just enough to persuade them.
“There is no next round for me.”
Strangely, watching him throw my entire plan into the trash before my eyes didn’t make me angry.
「“Yoo Joonghyuk, who was a regressor.”」
Only now did I truly feel the weight of what he had said then.
Until now, I had believed the Yoo Joonghyuk of this round had grown so quickly because of the information I gave him and other intervening variables. But I couldn’t say that anymore.
The Stories rising from his entire body were proof. Stories bearing the will to live, not the resolve to die.
「Yoo Joonghyuk had staked everything on this round.」
Like a train racing forward on every last bit of its fuel, Yoo Joonghyuk was living with all his strength.
This round was not material for his next life.
【…Captain, you’re lying, right? Huh? You’re joking, aren’t you?】
Lee Jihye’s expression twisted. It wasn’t simply the face of someone whose beliefs had been betrayed. It was the face of someone whose world was collapsing.
Reaching for the last straw of hope she had been seeking.
But Yoo Joonghyuk did not take that hand.
“Lee Jihye. Have I ever lied to you?”
【…Why.】
An explosive current of energy flowed from Lee Jihye’s whole body. I could feel the histories of the 999th round running wild.
【Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why Why】
The Stories were asking. Why here, instead of the 999th round? Why this world, instead of the one they had lived in?
When I stepped forward, Yoo Joonghyuk stopped me.
“Stay back.”
His cheek, trembling with pain. However hard he tried to hide his feelings, he couldn’t erase his distinctive habits. After a soft sigh, I spoke.
—There’s nowhere left to retreat anyway.
—I’m sorry.
—Forget it. You made your choice.

Yoo Joonghyuk might seem a realist at first glance, but he was more of an idealist than anyone. A man who didn’t pursue ideals would never have kept regressing in the first place. So to protect his ideals, someone had to be a realist.
Watching the furious waves of ‘Outer Gods’ surge toward us, I took another step forward.
[Yoo Joonghyuk did not reject your worldline.]
At the True Voice I released with all my strength, the panicking ‘Outer God kings’ turned toward me. The Lee Jihye, Lee Hyunsung, Kim Namwoon and Uriel of the 999th round…
[Have you forgotten? He was always the one being chosen, not the one choosing.]
Though he had regressed over and over, Yoo Joonghyuk had never once truly wanted to regress.
Even as he abandoned the third round for the fourth, the fourth for the fifth, it hadn’t truly been his will.
Regression was his fate, not his choice. It wasn’t Yoo Joonghyuk who chose, but the ‘story’ that wanted him to regress.
[We don’t need to fight each other. Why must tragedies compete over their suffering?]
I didn’t know whether these words would work. Even so, I had to say them.
[We will not exclude you. We don’t want to remember you as calamities. We—]
I looked up at the sky. The shower of immeasurable gazes, unlike anything I had ever witnessed, made me dizzy. But I didn’t look away.
Just as Yoo Joonghyuk was no longer the Yoo Joonghyuk of the zeroth round, I was no longer the Kim Dokja of Scenario 1.
[We want to stand against that sky together with you.]
Beyond the sky, the stars blazed madly.
[The vast majority of constellations do not understand your words!]
[The Bureau’s Great Dokkaebis are astonished by your thoughts!]
Indirect messages poured down like starlight.
Before, I would have been too busy reading them. But now I knew.
The starlight in that sky was only decoration to hide the darkness there.
[The ‘King of Stories’ is looking at you.]
That was when I heard a very faint laugh.
【Hey, do you even know what that means? Are you saying we should destroy the <Star Stream>?】
A sneering voice. The Kim Namwoon of the 999th round.
【You think we haven’t tried that?】
Deep furrows of emotion lay in his voice.
His face was smiling, but it wasn’t a real smile.
Resignation seeping into that exaggerated laughter.
【We tried too. Brought down every constellation, even killed our worldline’s Dokkaebi King. Know what happened?】
Kim Namwoon walked across the sea until he was right before me.
As though offering a sweet despair, he whispered.
【The world just disappeared.】
I listened silently.
【We cleared the scenario properly and fulfilled every condition…and still lost everything we loved. Without any miracle or reward.】
The words of the Uriel from the 999th round came to mind.
「If the <Star Stream> disappears, the universe turns to chaos. Such a worldline must not be created. That is Evil (惡).」
That was what she had said when I spoke of destroying the <Star Stream>.
Kim Namwoon continued.
【Do you know what we saw at that world’s end?】
[You must have seen an enormous wall. A vast wall enclosing all these worlds, whose beginning and end you couldn’t fathom.]
【…How do you know that?】
[Because our goal is there too. We don’t simply want to destroy the <Star Stream>.]
I repeated what ‘Secretive Plotter’ had told me, in my own voice.
[We want to eliminate the one responsible for all these tragedies, who must be beyond the ‘Final Wall.’]
The Kim Namwoon of the 999th round looked at me as though in deep shock.
His lips moved several times before he shouted.
【No one can cross the ‘Final Wall’! That’s—】
【Namwoon, they possess the ‘last key’ that may let them go beyond the ‘Final Wall.’】
It was Lee Hyunsung.
Confused, the Kim Namwoon of the 999th round looked back and forth between Lee Hyunsung and me.
I nodded toward the Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round.
[The ‘Outer God kings’ are shaken by your words!]
[Your declaration is causing a drastic change in ‘Scenario 98’!]
[Many constellations are outraged by your choice!]
It was all right if we couldn’t bring the stars to our side. All right if no nebula sided with us.
But if these beings took our side.
If the ‘kings’ who had lived the 999th round stayed in this worldline and fought with us—
【…Let’s say you have a ‘key’ like that.】
The instant I heard that voice, an icy chill ran down my spine.
【Then is there any reason I shouldn’t take that ‘key’ from you?】
The instant Kim Namwoon’s dagger darted in at my throat.
Claaang!
A black arc passing before my eyes intercepted it.
Under the heavy impact, Yoo Joonghyuk and Kim Namwoon both fell back a couple of steps.
【Hahaha! Yes! This is the feeling!】
After clashing with the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword], ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss’ was bleeding from the back of his hand.
【Do you know how long I’ve waited? Do you know how many years I’ve wandered to fight you one more time!】
‘Monarch of the Great Abyss.’
A being who had traveled through those distant ages to revive the one he admired once more.
[The Giant Story ‘Delusional Design’ begins its story!]
Uriel, supporting the staggering Lee Jihye, had already taken a fighting stance too.
【He told me once. If he ever became something other than himself, he wanted me to kill him with my own hands.】
With a dazzling roar, the sun in the sky shone again.
【It seems that time has come.】
The steel filling my vision blocked the blazing heat pouring down.
—Get away. I cannot stop them alone.
Unlike the others, the Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round had not been summoned as a ‘calamity.’
Which meant he did not have the ‘scenario’s protection’ they did.
“Kim Dokja!”
Almost at the same moment, my companions arrived.
Han Sooyoung, who had flown in on the Black Flame Dragon, asked first.
“What happened?”
“Just what it looks like.”
Han Sooyoung bit down hard on her lip.
I said nothing. Instead, I looked at my companions.
At Jung Heewon, Shin Yoosung, Lee Gilyoung, Lee Jihye and Yoo Sangah.
“This is the last hurdle.”
My companions probably felt it too.
“Please. Don’t die, any of you.”
In this fight, even I couldn’t protect them.
Kwoooooom!
With an impact that seemed to overturn heaven and earth, fierce tidal waves and sunlight crossed. Through the white foam filling my vision, I saw clashing blades.
An ink-black flash cleaving the sea.
Yoo Joonghyuk was fighting. Withstanding the combined attacks of the Kim Namwoon and Uriel from the 999th round, he displayed astonishing martial prowess.
[The Giant Story ‘Lonely Pilgrim of Destruction’ begins its story!]
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ begins its story!]
Power enough to face two ‘kings.’
That was Yoo Joonghyuk’s true strength.
All the Stories he had built were exploding at once.
[The connection of ‘Disconnected Film Theory’ is incomplete!]
[Cracks are forming in the continuity of the Stories!]
But that balance couldn’t last forever.
“Dokja-ssi.”
I turned to find Jung Heewon there. Dazzling wings of an archangel were blossoming from her back.
Beast Lord Shin Yoosung, Maritime Admiral Lee Jihye, Steel Sword Emperor Lee Hyunsung.
Companions who had lived lives different from those in the original novel, and were therefore moving toward different answers.
We glanced at one another and nodded.
“I’ll help Joonghyuk-ssi. The rest of you, take that side!”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ releases her Status!]
Spreading her wings, Jung Heewon flew toward Yoo Joonghyuk under Uriel’s protection.
It seemed to be Uriel’s choice. Now that she knew the ‘Outer God king’ was her own self in the distant future…
【I told you. You cannot face me without a nebula’s protection.】
[Flames of Retribution] rose as though to pierce the sky, then fell toward the sea.
But I had no time to worry about Jung Heewon. Someone was pouring immense Status toward us.
Through the bursting waves, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round stared at us with empty eyes.
“Everyone, dodge!”
Stepping forward, Yoo Sangah twisted spacetime. But with that ‘Outer God king’ fighting in earnest, Sakyamuni’s power was useless.
With a cracking sound, the twisted space was forcibly unfolded.
The battleship of the 999th round’s Lee Jihye was rising from the sea. ‘Master of the Sunken Island.’ Her [Turtle Dragon] looked less like a battleship than a literal island.
“Ajusshi!”
Sensing danger, Shin Yoosung had her [Chimera Dragon] unleash its breath. Then all the sea beasts hiding underwater surged out.
Gyaaaaaah!

Roaring fiercely, the monsters charged at the battleship’s outer hull. But the island was too enormous for them to stop. With a crunching sound, the monsters were crushed. The surrounding sea heaved heavily, and tidal waves swept in.
“Hyung, get back! Hurry!”
“Kim Dokja, get the hell back!”
My companions were fighting desperately, surrounding me as though to protect me.
I knew why they were going that far.
I knew very well what they feared too.
【Just get rid of everything, everything.】
Beyond the tidal wave, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round was shouting.

【We can make it all again. It’s nothing. Then the Captain will understand. That this is a world we can destroy as much as we like. That it can be replaced. That the world we lived in was the real one…!】
Krrrrash!
With cannon fire that seemed capable of blowing away the whole sea, a tsunami was sweeping in. A tidal wave larger than any I had ever seen.
If it kept sweeping forward like that, the Korean Peninsula would be finished, even with my mother there.
[The Story ‘Demon King of Salvation’ begins its story!]
Han Sooyoung’s face hardened as she shouted.
“Kim Dokja! If you do something stupid again—!”
“Don’t worry.”
I tapped her shoulder and stepped forward.
Scenes from the scenarios we had shared flashed before my eyes.
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ begins its story!]
[The Giant Story ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’ is beginning its story!]
[The Giant Story ‘Season of Light and Darkness’ begins its story!]
Every time a Giant Story was made, I had survived a brush with death.
I had believed I had to. Believed it was the right way.
[The Giant Story ‘The Liberator of the Forgotten Ones’ looks at you.]
The Golden Headband tightened firmly around my head.
The shackles my companions had fastened on me themselves.
When I gained this Giant Story, I hadn’t died. I knew very well that this reflected their feelings.
Kwoooooom!
The approaching tidal wave. A force even a Myth-grade constellation couldn’t stop.
「But Kim Dokja knew how to face that tidal wave.」
The original novel’s final round. When Yoo Joonghyuk fought his last war with the ‘Outer Gods,’ there had been a moment like this too.
Then, a constellation had stood beside him.
[The constellation ‘Most Ancient Liberator’ looks at you.]
One ‘Myth-grade constellation’ alone couldn’t withstand the ‘Great Apocalypse.’
But what about two?
[The constellation ‘Demon King of Salvation’ looks at ‘Most Ancient Liberator.’]
I would no longer sacrifice myself. Nor would I leave my companions behind.
Just as Yoo Joonghyuk wouldn’t give up on this life, I wouldn’t give up until the end either.
[The Giant Story ‘The Liberator of the Forgotten Ones’ begins its story!]
The only one of my ‘Giant Stories’ with the power to face an ‘Outer God king.’
I wasn’t the one who held the largest share of this Giant Story.
“Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal!”
I felt four rings connect inside my head.
[‘Meihouwang’ agrees to your request.]
[‘Bimawen’ agrees to your request.]
[‘Douzhanshengfo’ agrees to your request.]
The overflowing Stories were transforming my incarnation body.
[‘Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal’ agrees to the request.]
My hair grew in an instant and turned platinum. Immeasurable Story energy surged like a torrent through every blood vessel in my body.
The satisfying feel of Ruyi Jingu Bang in one hand.
[The power of five ‘Sun Wukongs’ manifests in your incarnation body!]
The golden Status of Stories settling over my coat. The battlefield of the Tongtian River was reappearing in the sea around us.
As thunder crashed, a voice reached me.
[Let’s go, youngest.]
I nodded.
Kwoooooom!
The Great Sage’s Status, enveloping my whole body, concentrated in the [Ruyi Jingu Bang] in my right hand. Just as it had on the day we faced the constellations at Tongtian River.
The difference was that now, I was using that ‘Sun Wukong’s’ power in full.
[The Giant Story ‘The Liberator of the Forgotten Ones’ dwells fully within you!]
“I’ll open a path.”
When I swung [Ruyi Jingu Bang], a great hole opened in the center of the approaching tidal wave. But it closed at once.
【No no no no no no】
‘Nameless Ones’ were crawling out of the island the Lee Jihye of the 999th round had raised.
There were far too many to fight, but the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal wasn’t particularly flustered.
[Break them.]
The arm I raised into the air tingled, and dark clouds covered the sky. Nimbus Clouds bearing thunderclouds shook the heavens several times. Then dazzling blue light scattered over the sea.
Kwoooooom!
Clusters of lightning bolts struck, tearing apart everything in the sea to open a path. Lightning striking again and again. The Status was immense.
This was the strength of the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal who had reached the final scenario—the one called the strongest constellation.
【Gagak gagagagagagagak?】
Yet some beings were barely withstanding even that raging lightning.
Individuals a little larger than the ones before.
【Kill con stel la tions】
【The de struc tion of all stars draws near】
‘Outer Gods’ who could use more precise language. Higher beings were passing through tunnels beneath the sea and rising to the surface.
“Crazy—”
Han Sooyoung shouted beside me.
Rrrrrumble!
The entire seabed shook, and lava boiled up from below.
“Everyone, fall back!”
We boarded Lee Jihye’s [Turtle Dragon] and soared into the air.
The sea’s pale surface was filled with writhing things.
【The de struc tion of the world line will come】
‘Outer Gods’ descending, spouting apocalyptic lines.
We had once encountered a being like them.
Early in the scenarios, on the battlefield of [Dark Castle].
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ stirs faintly.]
Perhaps the [Eater of Dreams], now a librarian within the Wall, was watching this scene too.
“How are we supposed to kill things like that?”
Gritting her teeth, Han Sooyoung released [Black Flames] from both hands.
Tentacles several kilometers long surged from the sea all at once, and the lava-covered tidal wave grew like a mountain range.
A sentence from ‘Ways of Survival’ suddenly came to mind.
「The calamity flowing from the risen island finally covered everything on the planet’s surface.」
If we let time pass like this, Earth in this worldline would end up the same.
“Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal!”
Borrowing his strength, I faced the approaching tidal waves.
The Ruyi Jingu Bang grew in an instant and struck the approaching ‘Nameless Ones.’ It shattered waves as large as buildings and smashed the incoming tentacles. Still, there was no end.
「The tidal waves only grew larger.」
When we overcame one tidal wave, a second tidal wave came. When we shattered the second tidal wave, a third tidal wave swept in.
And at the center of all those waves were ‘Master of the Sunken Island’ and the other ‘Outer God kings.’
[…It won’t be easy this time.]
Even the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal said as much.
At this rate, we would be defeated before we even reached them.
“Isn’t there a way to break through?”
[I need time.]
With those words, the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal, began gathering his Status. The area around my heart rapidly warmed, and the flow through my body’s Story channels sped up.
Knowing what he was preparing, I didn’t ask further. If I was right, he was about to use the technique that appeared in the final chapter of ‘Ways of Survival.’
The question was whether my companions and I could hold out until then.
「To buy time, we must join forces.」
However outstanding Uriel and the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon were as constellations, they would struggle to hold out on their own. Besides, the other side had four ‘kings.’
…Four?
Krrrrash!
A steel shield knocking away a mass of incoming tentacles.
Looking at the broad shoulders blocking my way, I spoke.
“Hyunsung-ssi.”
The Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round turned toward me. His face was half worry, half confusion.
“I need your help. Please help us stop this calamity.”
After studying me quietly, Lee Hyunsung asked.
【Can you promise?】
I didn’t ask what that promise was. I thought I knew.
“I don’t know if I can keep it. But I’ll do my best.”
After watching me briefly, Lee Hyunsung blinked slowly.
The next moment, his eyes shone silver.
【I will trust your Stories.】
Krrrrash!

Enormous branches of steel began growing from the ship’s side. They grew in an instant, formed walls on all four sides, then kept growing rapidly as they collided with the tidal waves and ‘Nameless Ones.’
Soon, a square passage, open through its center, had formed before us.
A passage made by racing walls of steel.
【Go.】
I nodded and ran down the passage.
How long had I been running? A familiar figure appeared at the passage’s end.
“Heewon-ssi!”
Jung Heewon was swinging her sword amid the ‘Nameless Ones.’ My companions and I crossed the passage to help her.
“I’m sorry. I just can’t get through.”
Biting her lip hard, Jung Heewon muttered in dejection. A voice tinged with despair.
Unable even to approach the Uriel of the 999th round, she was struggling just to cut down the ‘Nameless Ones’ flying at her.
【Gyaaaaaah】
With a crunch, the steel wall shook heavily. ‘Outer Gods’ charging as though they would swallow us at any moment.
If we took even one step out of this passage, they would tear us apart like piranhas.
Crunch, crunch.
I heard the ‘Nameless Ones’ gnawing at the metal walls.
“Watch out…!”
‘Nameless Ones’ were charging toward us from the passage’s exit. Tongues lolling, they rushed at us like rabid dogs.
【Aaaaaaah!】
The next moment, something like a flash of light fell from the sky, and everything before us was cut apart.
Someone outside had sliced through the passage we stood in.
Beyond the severed passage lay the battlefield of the Great Apocalypse.
Dead ‘Nameless Ones’ formed an island of corpses. At the sight of forgotten Stories dying so miserably, the children retched.
I, too, gazed over the battlefield, briefly lost for words.
Someone murmured in a tearful voice.
“Why go this far…?”
This was the ‘Great Apocalypse.’ The scenario the original Yoo Joonghyuk had fought through.
In fact, that Yoo Joonghyuk was confronting the ‘Outer God kings’ at the center of this vast battlefield even now.
Kwoooom!

A flash seemed to spark on one side of the clear sky, and a roar sounded from the other before I knew it. Movements almost too fast for the eye to follow. Those who had sliced through our passage were fighting.
Overwhelmed by the sight, I briefly forgot I was even on a battlefield.
[The Giant Story ‘Delusional Design’ displays its might!]
[The Giant Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ continues its story!]

The strongest beings of forgotten worldlines were pitting their Stories against one another. Surging [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] met [Hell Flames Ignition], and the remnants of [Black Flames] mixed in to form waterspouts.
Between the dark clouds, torrents of sword aura collided, and old Stories howled like ancient dragons. Their screams seemed to tear the sky away.
Living histories collided and vanished before my eyes.
And at the center of all those stories was Yoo Joonghyuk’s [Black Heavenly Demon Sword].
We couldn’t waste the time Yoo Joonghyuk had bought. Pointing ahead, I spoke.
“The cause of the tidal waves is the ‘sunken island’ itself.”
‘Nameless Ones’ swarming like clouds of dust. Outer Gods of higher Status raising tidal waves behind them. And the ‘sunken island’ at their center.
The Lee Jihye of the 999th round was probably at that island’s center.
“We need to sink the island first. Subduing the Lee Jihye of the 999th round would be best, of course.”
I tried to see beyond the barrage of tidal waves.
The cause of this ‘Great Apocalypse.’ Subduing the Lee Jihye of the 999th round, ‘Master of the Sunken Island,’ would calm the disaster. The problem was how to reach her.
Han Sooyoung spoke.
“The Kim Namwoon and Uriel of the 999th round are over there too. Even if Yoo Joonghyuk’s fighting Uriel, what are you going to do about Kim Namwoon?”
“Don’t worry. I have something in mind.”
We were still at a disadvantage in strength. We had already lost a considerable part of our fighting power in the earlier battle. But not everything was against us.

“Gilyoung, Yoosung. Release your insects and monsters to hold the Outer Gods back as much as possible. Sangah-ssi, please look for a chance to debuff Lee Jihye one more time. Han Sooyoung, deal with the ‘Nameless Ones’ approaching from behind us.”
“And you?”
“I’ll open the way. Heewon-ssi, come with me.”
As Jung Heewon nodded, I released my Status.
[The constellation ‘Demon King of Salvation’ releases his Status!]
At just the right moment, I felt Lee Hyunsung’s Stories envelop my body.
An outer layer formed by [Steel Transformation] was growing over my skin. Our trip to <Oz> had certainly been worth it.
We absolutely needed Lee Hyunsung’s [Story metal] to break the ‘Nameless Ones’ shells efficiently.
“Now!”
We leapt from the steel wall in the air together and plunged toward the tidal wave.
Noticing our movement, the ‘Outer Gods’ shrieked in unison.
Ratatatatat!
Gong Pildu’s shells, coated in [Story metal], flew in from afar. They pierced the ‘Nameless Ones’ shells. With his cannon fire as our interlude, we ran over the tidal wave.
It was Han Sooyoung who burned away the tentacles we had no room to dodge.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ roars!]
In the blaze of [Black Flames], the Outer Gods screamed in agony.
Jung Heewon and I ran along that path. I felt spacetime around the island warp faintly. Yoo Sangah was exerting her power.
“Dokja-ssi, there!”
In the distance, we saw an enormous [Turtle Dragon] occupying the island’s summit.
On its figurehead, the Maritime Admiral of the 999th round was commanding the ‘Outer Gods.’
【Hahaha, where do you think you’re going!】
As though he had been waiting, the Kim Namwoon of the 999th round appeared.
【I’ll protect our Jihye!】
Apparently, he could still afford to interfere even while fighting Yoo Joonghyuk. Perhaps Yoo Joonghyuk was in critical condition. I signaled to Jung Heewon.
“Don’t worry about me. Help Yoo Joonghyuk. He’ll be nearing his limit.”
“Don’t die, all right?”
Jung Heewon immediately spread her wings and vanished to help Yoo Joonghyuk.
【How touching. Don’t worry. I’ll send you both off in an instant!】
Kim Namwoon began to move smoothly.
His shadow split into hundreds, and countless figures sprang from it.
「Kim Dokja thought. There’s no dodging this.」

Hundreds—no, there looked to be easily thousands of daggers, all aimed at my entire body at once. Daggers that moved as though alive. Every one carried the essence of the Knife Fighting Kim Namwoon had mastered. Each an attack powerful enough to inflict a fatal wound. Even so, I smiled quietly.
“You swung a knife at me the first time I saw you too.”
【Isn’t this the first time I’ve seen you?】
“Kim Namwoon, aren’t you curious how the you of this world died?”
At those words, one of Kim Namwoon’s figures frowned.
【Why should I give a shit how that guy died!】
I blocked the flying daggers with [Ruyi Jingu Bang]. Some cut deep into my thigh and shoulder, but fortunately, Lee Hyunsung’s [Story metal] took his attacks for me.
Yet under the attacks pouring down like rain, even Lee Hyunsung’s steel was cracking.
I dodged the incoming attacks as though steadily reenacting a memory.
「Right flank」
「Right eye」
「Left thigh」
Tss, tssss.
Faint sparks flying.
I fell back after being struck by a couple more daggers.
“The you of this worldline was trash. A thug who tried to clear the first scenario by killing a helpless elderly person.”
【That’s how the first scenario works. I don’t care about that crap—】
“You swung your dagger just like now, then knelt pathetically and begged for your life. Then your head burst and you died miserably.”
For the first time, Kim Namwoon stopped moving.
All playfulness gone from his face, he glared at me.
“Aren’t you curious who killed you like that?”
A dagger flew at my left eye.
“O sword discarded to cut down the sleeping giant. Descend here and now!”
Kwoooooom!
With an immense shock wave, everything before my eyes warped.
A steel giant, summoned across dimensions, stood there.
Pluto, the strongest Story weapon in [Tartarus].
Kim Namwoon’s bright voice came from the cockpit.
[Hahahaha! Grasshopper Man, long time no…]
But I couldn’t smile. Because what I was about to do was terribly cruel to him.
[Huh? What’s this?]
Spotting something small floating right before him, Kim Namwoon tilted his head. Almost at the same moment, the Kim Namwoon over there muttered blankly.
【…A giant robot?】
[Waaaaaaaah!]
Tssssss!
[The same being from different worldlines has encountered itself for the first time!]
The Kim Namwoon of the 999th round had no Story of fighting me.
But what about now?
[‘Disconnected Film Theory’ is activating!]
Memories joined. As the two beings from different worldlines met, disconnected Stories temporarily became one.
Eyes wide, the Kim Namwoon of the 999th round, ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss,’ was glaring at me. Now he would know everything too.
【You…】
“That’s right. The one who killed the you of this worldline…”
The surrounding spacetime was changing. The subway of the first scenario.
The place where I had killed Kim Namwoon.
Smiling, I continued.
[‘Stage Transformation’ is activating!]
“…was me.”
[The Story ‘Ruler of Steel’ begins its story.]
The steel walls made by the Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round began growing around us.
In <Oz>, this power could defend an entire planet.
Krrrrash!
The growing steel soon combined with 「Stage Transformation」 to form the subway’s partitions.
A stage infinitely familiar to me. The compartment of the first scenario, still vivid whenever I closed my eyes.
[A Myth-grade constellation’s ‘stage’ has appeared!]
Tsssss!
Normally, 「Stage Transformation」 was closer to a kind of augmented reality. In other words, activating it didn’t actually change the surrounding terrain or objects.
But this time was a little different.
[The <Star Stream> focuses on your ‘stage.’]
[The vast majority of constellations are watching the ‘stage.’]

What ‘The Living Flame’ said next was wholly unexpected.
【Your Stories are very like those of the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ I knew. Your way of clearing scenarios, your way of caring for your companions.】
【This worldline is very like ours.】
Complicated feelings crossed the face of the Lee Jihye from the 999th round. Seeing that expression, I realized why they had looked at one another for so long.
It wasn’t simply because this world was their home that they were shaken.
【Do you know what happened in our worldline?】
I hesitated. It wasn’t something I could easily explain.
To make up for my lack of eloquence, my Stories began to speak.
[The Story ‘Demon King of Salvation’ begins its story.]
Some of my Stories went through my fingertips toward the beings of the 999th round.
[The Story ‘One Who Opposes the Extraordinary’ begins its story.]
[The Story ‘One Who Hunted the King of Disasters’ is beginning its story.]
I watched them read my Stories. Such varied expressions. It was obvious what they were overlaying my Stories with.
…Had I looked like that when I first read ‘Ways of Survival’?
It was something I could never know.
【…How could this…】
That was when something unexpected happened. As the Uriel of the 999th round silently read my Stories, her Status traveled along them and infiltrated my mental world.
As though trying to discover the origin of my existence.
[The exclusive skill ‘Fourth Wall’ activates!]
Tssss!
Dazzling sparks flew, and the ‘Wall’ moved as expected.
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ glares at ‘The Living Flame’!]
‘The Living Flame’ had been flung back as though repelled, and her left hand was faintly scorched.
A faint understanding appeared in her surprised gaze.
【I see. So that was it. You are…】
A voice more startled than when she had read my memories.
【The last fragment of the Final Wall… Is that why ‘Secretive Plotter’ is so obsessed with you?】
“Make your decision. The scenario’s end is close now.”
[The ‘Great Apocalypse Scenario’ has temporarily entered a lull.]
[If the current state continues for too long, the world’s distortion will accelerate.]
Now that they had descended as ‘calamities,’ the scenario had to be brought to an end.
For now, the best we could hope for was that they would give up being ‘calamities.’
‘The Living Flame’ spoke again.
【I acknowledge your potential. Though it galls me, I can even agree to postpone my revenge. But—】
Countless emotions passed over her face.
【I do not believe you can reach the world’s end. I do not believe beings who have merely imitated the Stories of another worldline can see a proper ending.】
“Wait—”
【When this scenario ends, you will reach your ‘Conclusion.’】
The final part of A Single Story: the Conclusion (結).
A terrifying blast of heat was gathering around the Uriel of the 999th round. The vaporized sea breeze left the smell of salt in my nose.
At that tremendous change in Status, I cried out instinctively.
“Yoo Joonghyuk!”
Stepping forward at once, Yoo Joonghyuk cut through the hot wind with the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword]. But even the backs of his hands were cooking in the heat.
Irregular breathing. The effects of [Disconnected Film Theory] had almost worn off.
Rrrrrumble!
The Giant Stories of the 999th round stirred all at once. For some reason, this time even the Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round didn’t stop Uriel.
I shouted urgently.
“Why…? There’s no need for this! We—”
Without a word, the Uriel of the 999th round walked toward us.
Tense, my companions released their Status to meet hers in unison.
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ continues its story!]
[The Giant Story ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’ continues its story!]
‘The Living Flame,’ approaching with contempt for our Stories.
Having received the Status of all the other ‘Outer Gods,’ she raised [Flames of Retribution].
I bit down hard on my lip.
[The vast majority of constellations fear the power of the ‘Outer Gods’!]
[Many Great Dokkaebis loathe the Stories of the ‘Outer Gods.’]
Everything in the <Star Stream> becomes a story.
But why was a story like this necessary, when neither the constellations nor the dokkaebis wanted it?
Why did this story, which only plunged everyone into boundless sorrow, exist in the world?
【Do you always craft your Stories for someone to hear?】
The Uriel of the 999th round was speaking.
The astonishingly refined [Flames of Retribution] spoke of time outside the scenarios.
【For whom do the Stories you have built exist?】
Hearing that True Voice, I understood her intent.
A story no one sponsored.
Even so, she wanted to see this scenario’s end.
「This was the answer ‘The Living Flame’ had chosen.」
She didn’t wish to continue this scenario because she agreed with the constellations or wanted to ride along with the <Star Stream>.
【Show me your ‘Conclusion.’ Prove to me that you can reach an ending different from any other worldline’s.】

The stars in the sky were watching us. Stars who had watched this story for a very long time. I imagined those countless points of starlight, then the end of all these worlds that would lie beyond them.
I imagined the ending of this story, which I had pictured for so very long.
“Kim Dokja!”

A wave of blazing heat filling my sight. The [Hell Flames Ignition] of the Uriel from the 999th round mingled with the smell of burning sulfur, forming a tidal wave of lava. A wave of immense Status that would melt everything on contact.
One clash would decide it.
If we stopped that, we could win.
“Everyone, concentrate on the Giant Stories!”
Petty tricks were useless before a calamity.
Instead of using their own specialties, my companions helped wield the Giant Stories.
Shin Yoosung, Lee Gilyoung, Yoo Sangah. All of them stretched both hands into the air and lent strength to their shares in the Giant Stories.
[The Giant Story ‘Season of Light and Darkness’ begins its story!]
With the sound of the sky splitting, I heard the Apocalypse Dragon’s roar.
The next moment, a rough roar burst from Han Sooyoung’s side.
Rooooooar!
The ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon,’ who had been a candidate for the final Apocalypse Dragon, was unleashing his breath.
Riding the fierce backdraft of [Black Flames], Jung Heewon ran forward.
[The constellation ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’ releases her Status!]
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ releases her Status!]
Two archangels were with Jung Heewon.
Raised high into the sky, the [Sword of Judgement] swept straight down into the tidal wave.
Kwoooooom!
Perhaps because of the two angels’ combined attack, the tidal wave slowed for an instant.
Yoo Joonghyuk didn’t miss the opening.
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ continues its story!]
Afterimages of countless rounds, stretching from the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword].
His Status scattered outward, breaking the approaching waves.
—Not enough.
But Yoo Joonghyuk couldn’t keep fighting for long. The sparks across his whole body were growing more intense. The effects of [Disconnected Film Theory] had finally worn off.
At the very instant his Status rapidly diminished, Yoo Joonghyuk struck the center of the wave.
Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship (破天劍道).
Secret Art (奧義).
Dark Ocean Slash (暗海斬).
The tiny opening his secret art made.
I didn’t miss it.
[Youngest, I’m ready.]
Then I heard the voice I had been waiting for.
The surrounding clouds gathered as though to envelop me. The Nimbus Cloud, brimming with lightning, surrounded me. My whole body trembled as though I had drawn in every thunderbolt in the sky.
[You can use it only once.]
Kicking off the clouds, I ran through the narrowing gap in the lava.
The wings formed by [Demon King Transformation] caught fire, and the terrible heat seemed to sear my very vision. But I didn’t stop.
I had a duty to protect this path that all my companions had opened for me.
「A single story that would stand as proof of our lives.」
My ever-accelerating feet soon became light.
I endured, using [Electrification] to hold together an incarnation body that seemed ready to burst at any moment.
Faster, stronger.
As though I myself had become a bolt of lightning.
Rrrrrumble!
Fully charged lightning seethed in both hands.
Lightning that had crushed countless stars of the <Star Stream> and half destroyed <Emperor>’s Heavenly Palace.
With all my strength, I threw the Ruyi Jingu Bang.
「The stars in the sky trembled, and the nebulae shrank back. Only the dark clouds covering the sky hinted at their despair.」
This was a blow containing all the power of the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal.
「As it had been on his final battlefield.」
Lightning advancing, shattering all the surging lava.
Krrrrash!
The exploding tidal wave burned away in its entirety. The lightning stretching onward made a path over the split wave.
The path of Stories we had walked all along. I ran down it.
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ makes arrangements for your ‘Conclusion.’]
The Demon Realm’s Introduction (起).
[The Giant Story ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’ guides you, huffing.]
Olympus’s Development (承).
[The Giant Story ‘Season of Light and Darkness’ stands by your side.]
The Great War of Saints and Demons’ Climax (轉). And—
[The Giant Story ‘The Liberator of the Forgotten Ones’ dreams of the final Story.]
The final point still left unfilled.
Kwoooooom!
All the Stories we had lived through intertwined and shone brilliantly. A storm of light, bright enough to blind, engulfed everything.

When I raised my head, volcanic ash from the lava was drifting through the sky. A sky left in ruins after everything had ended. Fallout that hid the stars’ gazes fluttered like snow and covered the sea.
Someone was slumped before [Unbreakable Faith].
The archangel’s broken wings. From the start, she hadn’t intended to defeat us.
I looked quietly into both her eyes.
I couldn’t tell whether this had proved anything.
But this was the best I could show at this point.

For a long time, the Uriel of the 999th round looked at the sword’s tip. As though turning the last sentence over and over in her mind. As though that sharp point were a full stop that would end all her Stories.
Her gaze slowly moved in the direction the sword pointed.
Beyond the distant horizon where sky and sea met.
「There lay this worldline’s end.」
A faint tremor crossed Uriel’s expression.
The Lee Jihye and Lee Hyunsung of the 999th round, and even the dazed Kim Namwoon, looked that way too.
Beyond the pale fallout, something showed dimly through.
Fear appeared on the faces of the ‘Outer Gods.’
I realized what they were seeing.
The place they had already reached once in the 999th round.
The ‘Final Wall,’ impossible to cross as long as one lived with one’s feet planted in this world of ‘Stories.’
[The calamities of the ‘Great Apocalypse Scenario’ relinquish their rights as calamities.]
[The ‘Great Apocalypse Scenario’ enters its termination sequence!]
[Your final ‘Giant Story’ blooms!]
[The vast majority of constellations watch your final Story awaken!]
I heard that Wall calling me.
[Hidden Scenario—‘A Single Story’ has reached its ‘Conclusion’!]
[The <Star Stream> considers the name of your final Story.]
[You have accomplished a feat that inspires awe in every star of the <Star Stream>!]
[You have pioneered an epic that only a tiny number of stars have ever reached!]
Then the message I had awaited for so long appeared.
[You and your nebula have earned the right to see the ‘■■ of everything.’]
[The ‘King of Stories’ summons you.]
